about: Amendment 12 (post hoc): the claim-level correction layer for Stage C. claims.json and scores.json keep the as-judged verdicts; score_c.py applies these entries to write scores_corrected.json. Every entry names its claim, the change and its reason. No provider was re-run and no claim was re-judged: the corrections come from the recorded data, the KB baseline and the PR #38 review's evidence.

rules.novelty: Primary: the KB checkout at 2a055dc counts as known, _scratch/ included (the page's stated rule, applied to every question). A new claim is corrected to known only when everything it states is in the baseline or in a claim another judge found known. The correction layer doesn't overrule a judge's reading of a main-KB leaf the judge used.
rules.tiers: Tier 1 is a figure that enters a line's arithmetic (prereg:313-314); tier 2 is supply and named adoption (prereg:315). o5's supply shares move to tier 2. For the primary, g3 and m3 aren't 'the denominator the sizing uses' (SV's own kb_context says 'Not used by the sizing'), so their tier-1 claims move to tier 2; prices stay tier 1 on any question (g3#29, m3#45).
rules.dedupe: A fact written in two or more questions counts once per provider-arm. Two claims are one fact when they are on the same verified URL (normalized: scheme, www., trailing slash, default.aspx and Wayback notes dropped) and state the same figure or statement, or when a second page relays the same statistic. Attribution, praise quotes and 'gives no figure' caveats don't make a claim different. The fact takes the tier of the claim in the question it belongs to (the canonical); failing a facet match, the primary page; failing that, the earlier question in SV's order. A claim that only restates claims another question wrote separately (a bundle) isn't counted for a provider-arm already credited with all of them. A claim that adds a figure or term stays its own fact; claims contained in it stay too. A fact is known if any of its claims is known.

tavily_prereg330.rule: prereg:330: 'A run the caps refuse is logged as skipped and scored as returning nothing.' The 800-credit cap refused o3 (logged skipped_cap); m2, m3 and m6 were waiting under the guard when the run was stopped. Amendment 10 re-ran all four; the primary scores them as returning nothing, so Tavily research's items on those questions are out, with their 131 credits.

rules.stage_b_novelty: Sensitivity: Stage B's rule (prereg:265, '_scratch/ research notes don't count as the KB'), applied mechanically: every claim known only through _scratch/ paths in its kb_file counts as new. The fact groups above cover those claims too, so a fact written twice is still counted once.
rules.g3m3_counted: Sensitivity: g3 and m3 keep the tier 1 that SV gives them.
rules.amendment10: Sensitivity: Amendment 10's scoring, with Tavily research's four re-runs counted.
